Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Set up internal support information for your lab

Body.Content:
As a lab owner, you can now set up internal support information for a lab so that users know whom to contact internally when they run into a problem.

This information can include links to important wikis, helpful internal email addresses, links to slack channels, answers to frequently asked questions, and so on. The page serves as a customized help document that your team can reach out to before asking for external help.

For more information, go to our team blog.
